metadata.title: That One Kill Where Valorant Said ‘Go Ahead, We’re Confused Too’
metadata.description:
Aiming was definitely NOT on point.
Enemy probably questioning reality right now.
Valorant logic doing its usual magic.

Ever get a kill you didn’t even try for?

Hit like if your aim was on vacation but kills still happened!

#valorant #funnygaming #luckykill #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
